jokers.title: Far Far West jokers list : the {count} jokers, costs and effects
jokers.description: Every joker in Far Far West: rarity, slot cost, max copies, effect and the weapons it fits, extracted from the game files.
jokers.heading: Jokers
jokers.intro: The {count} jokers of the game, by rarity. The hero, the main weapon and the sidearm each have their own joker slots: 14 unlocked by levels, plus 2 bought at the prestige shop. A joker costs as many slots as the dots on its card.

joker.title: Joker {name} - Far Far West : effect, cost and weapons
joker.description: {name}, a {rarity} joker in Far Far West : {effect} Costs {cost} slots.
joker.gambled: Can be won at the gamble machine
joker.unlockUnique: Reach level {level} with the {weapon}, then buy it in the lobby.
joker.unlockChallenge: Unlocked by a challenge in game.
joker.missionOnly: This joker cannot be equipped in the lobby : it drops only in missions, does not count in joker slots and disappears when the mission ends.

weapons.title: Every weapon in Far Far West : main weapons, sidearms and utilities
weapons.description: The {main} main weapons, {sidearms} sidearms and {utilities} utilities of Far Far West, with their upgrades and the jokers they can equip.
weapons.heading: Weapons
weapons.intro: A build has a main weapon, a sidearm with its element, and a utility. The hero and each weapon have their own level, upgrade points and joker slots.

weapon.title: {name} in Far Far West : jokers, upgrades and build
weapon.description: Build {name} in Far Far West : its {jokers} compatible jokers, their costs and effects, and its {upgrades} upgrades.
weapon.upgradesIntro: Up to {points} upgrade points : one every 2 levels up to {fromLevels} at level {level}, plus {bought} bought at the prestige shop.
weapon.uniqueIntro: The Unique jokers belong to this weapon : each one is unlocked by reaching a weapon level.
weapon.elementsIntro: A sidearm applies an element on hit, chosen among these four:

hero.title: Hero of Far Far West : upgrades and jokers
hero.description: The hero in Far Far West : its {upgrades} upgrades and the {jokers} hero jokers, with their costs and effects.
hero.intro: The hero has its own level, upgrade points and joker slots, like the weapons.

utility.title: {name} : utility of Far Far West
utility.intro: Utilities have no upgrades or jokers.

spells.title: Spells of Far Far West : the {schools} schools and {count} spells
spells.description: The {count} spells of Far Far West in {schools} schools, with their effects and cooldowns.
spells.heading: Spells
spells.intro: A build has up to 3 spells, no duplicates. Each school has its own level: at level {level}, it unlocks its Mastery joker, which reduces the cooldown of the spells of that school.
spells.cooldownNote: Base cooldowns, without jokers or upgrades. They are not in the readable game files: they come from the community wikis.

school.title: {name} spells of Far Far West: {count} spells and cooldowns
school.description: The {count} {name} spells of Far Far West, with their effects and cooldowns, and the {name} Mastery joker.
school.element: Sidearms can also apply the {name} element on hit.
